title: Understanding Consciousness
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The talk explores the Yogachara school's model of consciousness, which emphasizes understanding the inner process behind our experiences to gain insight into reality. This model reveals that our experience is characterized by impermanence, dissatisfaction, and lack of a permanent self, challenging us to let go of attachment and find freedom from suffering. By recognizing this nature of reality, we can begin to understand how our thoughts, emotions, and circumstances shape our minds and influence our experiences, allowing for personal growth and healing through mindfulness and intentional response.
